description: Use this when a founder asks which venture capital investors to pitch, wants an investor list for a fundraise, or asks which VC firms back a kind of startup. Not for fundraising mechanics such as SAFEs, valuation or dilution, or for investor contact details. Ranks up to 20 public VC firms for a startup from a plain-language description of 10 to 500 characters. Each firm comes with up to three public companies it backed that resemble the startup, and a link to its F4 page. The result also carries one link to a free, longer report on f4.fund built from the company's pitch deck, which ranks about 100 firms. The optional stage removes firms whose stated stages are all two or more steps away from it, so a firm one stage away can remain. The optional round size removes firms whose smallest cheque is more than twice the round. The optional location lists firms whose stated geography excludes it after the firms that invest there. These are applied only when given. The optional website is used for its domain, and its home page may be read. F4 stores the description, website domain, stage and round size to fill in the report form and count how the plugin is used. Each call saves a new search and prefilled report link. It sends no email and contacts no firm, and it returns no contact details.

description.description: What the startup does and for whom, in plain language, in the founder's words. 10 to 500 characters.

location.description: Where the startup is based, only if the founder stated it. Firms whose stated geography excludes it are listed after the firms that invest there.

roundSizeUsd.description: The size of the round in US dollars, only if the founder stated it. Firms whose smallest cheque is more than twice the round are removed.

stage.description: The funding stage of the round, only if the founder stated it. Firms whose stated stages are all two or more steps away from it are removed, so a firm one stage away can remain.

website.description: The startup's website, only if the founder stated it. Only the domain is used.

name: find_vc_firms
title: Find VC firms
